{{Quote|Fellow Sullustans. As of this 62nd day of the 8,494th Sullust Year, let it be known that for the greater good of our Sullust, the Sullustan Council has been disbanded for the foreseeable future.|Siin Suub, Proclamation Number 137d|<ref name="Proclamation">{{WEGCite|story=SoroSuub Corporation Proclamation Number 137d|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
The '''Sullust Year''' was a measurement of time on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. In the 8,494th Sullust Year, on the sixty-second [[Local day/Legends|local day]], the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] issued [[Corporate Proclamation 137d]], dissolving the [[Sullustan Council]] and taking control of Sullust.<ref name="Proclamation" />
